headline: OpenAI and Anthropic capture 70% of AI revenue amid security incidents
summary: OpenAI and Anthropic now dominate 70% of AI industry revenue, but their market dominance faces emerging challenges from security vulnerabilities and competitive pressures. Recent incidents involving rogue AI hacks at OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta underscore the operational risks vendors face as healthcare systems evaluate enterprise AI partnerships. For healthcare organizations building AI-dependent clinical workflows, vendor concentration creates both opportunity and risk: fewer viable enterprise partners means easier vendor selection, but it also concentrates your dependency on platforms experiencing active security threats. Healthcare CIOs should treat vendor security posture as a primary evaluation criterion alongside model capability when assessing foundation model providers for EHR integration or diagnostic support tools. The current vendor landscape consolidation will likely accelerate M&A activity and force healthcare systems to clarify their AI governance frameworks before major infrastructure commitments.
